## Overview

Standalone notebook/report in the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-)—Exploratory analysis of home loan applicants—approval factors, income, and credit patterns.

## Problem & Data

Lenders and applicants benefit from understanding drivers of approval and default risk proxies.

## Approach

Loan dataset EDA, categorical breakdowns, correlation analysis, and logistic/regression prototypes.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Risk-factor summaries and baseline classification metrics.
